selectors.exact: The Team plan is supported until 31 March 2030.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre states every workspace exports to Markdown and JSON with the JSON schema published, which is the level-5 condition; the API reference qualifies it by documenting bulk-endpoint exports in an open schema, narrowing scope without contradicting it.

selectors.exact: Export every workspace to Markdown and JSON; the JSON schema is published in our API reference.
Exports produced by the bulk endpoint are documented in the open Notes Interchange schema, version 2.

cell.justification: Sits between the level-3 anchor (proprietary format only) and the level-5 anchor (all data in an open, documented format): notes and folders export to plain Markdown, but comments and attachments export only as a proprietary .mossarchive bundle.

selectors.exact: Notes and folders export to plain Markdown. Comments and attachments export only as a .mossarchive bundle, readable by Mossnote.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre states a self-serve move is available at any time, with a stated limit that completeness depends on the export formats the data supports; that is the level-3 condition, and the stated limit rules out level 5.

selectors.exact: You can move your team off Quillbase yourself at any time. How complete the move is depends on the export formats your data supports; see the export guide.
Industry-leading support, there for your team whenever you need it.

cell.justification: inferred from span-1 and span-2: the vendor's help centre says moving off Mossnote is handled by its paid Migration Services team, and a consultancy blog states a paid engagement is required for organisations over 50 seats; together they meet the level-1 condition, though the requirement is stated explicitly only for larger organisations.

selectors.exact: Moving an organisation off Mossnote is handled by our paid Migration Services team.
Mossnote requires a paid engagement with its own services team to migrate an organisation of more than 50 seats.

cell.justification: The help centre states the migration assistant moves a workspace with no vendor help, a self-serve path, but carries across only what the export tool can produce; that stated limit is the level-3 condition and rules out level 5.

selectors.exact: Larkpad's migration assistant moves your workspace without any help from us, and it carries across exactly what the export tool can produce, nothing more.

cell.justification: The developer docs state every workspace, including comments and attachments, exports as JSON following a published schema, which meets the all-data condition; the span never uses the word open, so the open-format part is inferred from the published schema and the OpenNotes name.

selectors.exact: Every workspace, including comments and attachments, exports as JSON that follows the published OpenNotes 1.2 schema.
